title: 第15章 俳句写成卜算子第16章 炫鸭翼的土匪
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 马修又何尝不明白，自己这伙人已经变成了绯约大公的黑手套，干着官方劫掠的活儿。
对马修这种脑袋别裤腰带上，干杀头买卖的人来说，给谁卖命其实都不是什么事，问题这绯约大公剥削的也太狠了，每次劫掠冲在最前面的，死的都是盗贼们，可结算战利品的时候却要上贡九成的物资。
马修不是没想过反，只是这胡安特警惕性高，战力又强，实在不好动手。
即便成功杀了这胡安特又如何，你斗得过绯约大公吗？回头就组织军队来剿匪了。
现在马修是一根筋两头堵，顶上受这胡安特的气，天天要满足他一系列要求，往下要受下属们的诘问，工作是越来越难，收益是越来越少，许多盗匪宁可收刀不干回家种地也不愿意继续跟着马修的盗贼团了。
“不给物资，那把那个娘们给兄弟们泄泄火总行吧，弟兄们都憋得慌，最近城里抓的严也进不去，不给大家伙放松放松，我怕管不住他们”
马修看向那被丢在车里的女炼金术师，先前抓人时，他还上下起手过些许，手感不错。
柔软中带着弹性。
也不知道这娘们搞那么多钱干什么，但从这炼金术师手里搞到的大量货币早在得手的第一时间就被胡安特加急派人送走了，现在劫掠的物资又只给一车，马修是很不满的。
不满归不满，又无法反抗胡安特，所以把注意力转向这炼金术师身上。
“不可能”
胡安特冷漠的扭头，露出其标志性的刀疤脸，据说这是当年他作为先锋骑士面对入侵领地的魔族牛头大将时留下的伤痕，牛头大将的巨斧砍在他的脸上，将头盔都斩裂开来，但骑士未曾后退一步。
“她是大魔女尼伯龙根的弟子，忤逆绯约大公的小丑，大公要亲眼看着她的皮被完整的剥下来，做成旗帜展出，肉被割下，饲育大公的猎犬，骨骼雕琢成火把，照亮大公的宫殿，要让那魔女看到，对抗大公的下场。”
“管不住手下人是你的问题，大公不介意换一个人统领盗贼团”
胡安特的话语令马修一阵恶寒
妈妈呀这也太凶残了吧。
即便是盗贼团这帮人渣里的人渣，顶多也不过玩腻了之后丢弃到山里，这贵族老爷这都干的啥事呀？
这么一对比，马修怀念起蒙特维尔男爵的好了，男爵抓了盗贼之后还会公审，完了顶多推到集市口斩首，这可比绯约大公动不动扒皮去骨要文明多了。
自己这些盗贼要是敢反抗，恐怕也会落得这个炼金术师的下场吧。
马修正想着，身后突然传来一阵中气十足的声音
“这样啊，你们果然是魔修啊”
立即转身，马修顺势拔出腰间的砍刀，只见一位扎起黑色长发，面容迥异的异国青年正站在营地中央，一只手背在身后，另一只手握着一捆长鞭，正在拍打身上的灰尘树叶。
只见那青年穿着一身白衣，好似风度翩翩的公子，可衣摆处却沾满了暗红色的血迹，仿佛刚从血河之中踏过。
“七丘帝国的遗民吗，有趣，不好好在叙拉古待着，来洛瑟兰管什么闲事”
胡安特侧身看向青年，言语中充满着嘲弄。
“哦？这方世界居然也有和我面庞相似的人种吗？这倒是新发现”
“不管你是谁，敢来闯我马修的营地，简直是活腻了”
马修抓起腰间的铃铛，叮铃铃的摇晃起来
“小的们，起来狩猎了”
围猎战术，马修从野外捕猎的狼群那边学到的战术，再强大的战士面对围攻也难以全身而退，即便是雄狮，也抵挡不住群狼的围攻。
随着铃铛的摇晃，一阵劲风袭来，周围传来了阵阵窸窣声，笑容逐渐浮现在马修脸上。
content_en:
Why didn't Matthew understand that his group had become the black gloves of Grand Duke Feiyue, doing official robbery?
For a person like Matthew who has his head in his belt and is engaged in the beheading business, it doesn't really matter who he works for. The problem is that Grand Duke Feiyue exploits him too hard. The thieves who are at the forefront of every robbery are the ones who die. However, when the loot is settled, 90% of the supplies must be paid.
It's not that Matthew hasn't thought about counterattack, it's just that Huante is highly vigilant and has strong combat power, so it's really difficult to do anything.
Even if you succeed in killing Huante, so what? Can you defeat Grand Duke Feiyue? Then he organized an army to suppress the bandits.
Now Matthew is stuck at both ends. He is angry at Huante. He has to meet a series of his demands every day, and he has to be questioned by his subordinates. The work is getting harder and harder, and the income is getting less and less. Many bandits would rather stop working and go home to farm than continue to follow Matthew's group of thieves.
"If you don't give me supplies, then I'll give that bitch to the brothers to vent their anger on the main office. The brothers are all in a panic. The city has been so tight recently that they can't even get in. If I don't let the big guys relax, I'm afraid I won't be able to control them."
Matthew looked at the female alchemist who was thrown in the car. When he arrested the person earlier, he had moved his hands up and down a little, and he felt good about it.
Soft yet elastic.
I don’t know what this girl is doing with so much money, but the large amount of currency obtained from the alchemist was sent away by Huante as soon as he got it. Now that the looted materials are only given to one cart, Matthew is very dissatisfied.
Dissatisfied and unable to resist Huante, he turned his attention to the alchemist.
"impossible"
Huante turned his head indifferently, revealing his iconic scarred face. It is said that this was the scar left when he faced the demonic bull-headed general who invaded the territory as a pioneer knight. The bull-headed general's giant ax struck his face, splitting his helmet, but the knight never took a step back.
"She is a disciple of the great witch Nibelungen, a clown who disobeyed the Grand Duke Fei Yue. The Grand Duke will see her skin completely peeled off and made into a flag for display. Her flesh will be cut off and she will be raised as a hound for the Grand Duke. Her bones will be carved into a torch to light up the Grand Duke's palace. He will let the witch see the consequences of resisting the Grand Duke."
"It's your problem that you can't control your subordinates. The Grand Duke doesn't mind having someone else lead the band of thieves."
Juante's words gave Matthew a chill.
Mom, this is too cruel.
Even if he is a scumbag among the scumbags of the thieves group, the best he can do is throw him into the mountains after getting tired of playing. What is this noble man doing?
Such a comparison made Matthew miss the Baron of Montville. After the baron caught the thief, he would be put on trial. At most, he would be beheaded at the entrance of the market. This was much more civilized than the Grand Duke Feiyue, who was always skinning and removing the bones.
If thieves like me dare to resist, I'm afraid they will end up like this alchemist.
As Ma Xiu was thinking about it, a breathy voice suddenly came from behind him.
"That's right, you are indeed demon cultivators."
"Who!"
Immediately turning around, Matthew pulled out the machete from his waist and saw an exotic young man with long black hair tied up and a very different face standing in the center of the camp. One hand was behind his back, and the other hand was holding a bundle of whips, beating the dust and leaves on his body.
I saw that the young man was wearing white clothes, like a handsome young man, but the hem of his clothes was stained with dark red blood, as if he had just stepped in a river of blood.
"Are you a remnant of the Seven Hills Empire? It's interesting. Why don't you stay in Syracuse and mind your own business in Lotherland?"
Huante turned sideways and looked at the young man, his words full of mockery.
"Oh? Are there actually people with faces similar to mine in this world? This is a new discovery."
"No matter who you are, you dare to come to my Matthew's camp, you are simply tired of living."
Matthew grabbed the bell on his waist and started to jingle.
"Little ones, get up and hunt."
Hunting tactics are tactics that Matthew learned from wolves hunting in the wild. No matter how powerful the warrior is, it will be difficult for him to retreat unscathed from the siege. Even a male lion cannot withstand the siege of a pack of wolves.
As the bell swayed, a gust of wind came, and there were rustling sounds all around. A smile gradually appeared on Matthew's face.
